name: Idle Breakout 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Idle Breakout is a clicker idle game that mirrors elements of the classic Atari arcade game, combining retro brick-smashing with incremental mechanics. When nostalgia and addictive progression loops of idle games meet, you get a game that is hard to put down, which is what makes this game one of the most popular in our collection.
